units.source_text: 我拿到了究竟顶的钥匙。

en.t: I obtained the key to the Kukyōchō.

units.source_text: 这是金阁的第三层楼阁，尤为珍贵，

en.t: This was the third-story pavilion of the Golden Pavilion, and it was especially precious,

units.source_text: 在离地面42尺高的门楣上，高雅地悬挂着一幅后小松帝①的御笔横匾。

en.t: on the lintel forty-two shaku above the ground, a horizontal plaque in Emperor Go-Komatsu's own hand hung elegantly.
